verdict.rationale: Make is a workflow automation platform, so running a code step is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents no JavaScript or Python code module inside scenarios. The built-in data-transformation functions (make-docs-8) and the custom-apps framework (make-docs-10) are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a code-execution step.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop into real code (JavaScript or Python) as a step inside a workflow
